description:
Section 73 Application (Minor Material Amendment) to vary Condition 2 (Approved Drawings) and Condition 4 (Windows) of planning permission reference P2025/1880/FUL, dated 25/09/2025, for the erection of a replacement single-storey rear extension at lower ground level and installation of replacement double-glazed sash timber windows to the front elevation. 

The proposed amendments include alteration to extension's brick finishes, roof covering from zinc to felt, front lower ground window from timber sash to timber casement and increase the depth of extension by 200mm
decision_conditions:
S73 - CONSENT LIMITED TO THAT OF ORIGINAL PERMISSION: The development hereby permitted shall be begun not later than the expiration of 24 September 2025. 

REASON: To ensure the commencement timescale for the development is not extended beyond that of the original planning permission granted on 24 September 2025 (LBI reference P2025/1880/FUL). Furthermore, to comply with the provisions of Section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as amended by the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004 (Chapter 5).
